design.title: Design
design.customFontHint: Upload your font (woff2, woff, ttf or otf). Overrides the one above.
design.musicHint: Plays when the menu opens, after the visitor's first tap.
design.presetsHint: Applies colours, type and layout in one go. You can fine-tune anything afterwards.
design.inlineOptionsHint: Lists a product's options (“choose your protein”) under the description, like a paper menu.
design.navBarHint: Each category's icon or image is uploaded when editing the category, under Menu.
design.titleAuto: Only when it has no subcategories
design.fullWidthHeader: Bar and categories span the full width
design.showSlogan: Show the slogan on the menu
design.logoWideHint: Used by the bar header, centred between “Back” and “Reserve”. That bar is usually dark, so “Always the dark one” tends to be right here.
design.faviconHint: The little icon in the browser tab. Square and simple — it renders at 16px. Left empty, the logo is used.
design.brandHint: Upload the light version and, if you have one, the dark. Leave the dark empty and the light one is used everywhere — nothing changes from today.
design.logoHint: The round logo, above the restaurant name.
design.coverHint: Wide image at the top of the menu.
design.whatsappBubbleHint: Floating button in the corner. Uses the WhatsApp number from Contact and works even when the menu is showcase-only.
design.headerHint: The top of the menu: logo, name and shortcuts.
design.logoWideHeightHint: Upload the horizontal logo under Brand. Without one, the bar falls back to the round logo.
design.imageMaxHeightHint: Stops a portrait shot — a bottle, say — from taking over whole screens.

pwa.installBody: Open it as an app and get alerts for new reservations.
pwa.installIosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari's bar.
pwa.installIosStep3: Open Kuik from the new icon.
pwa.installIosSignIn: The installed app keeps its own session, so you'll need to sign in once more the first time.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.subtitle: Connect your number and let Kuik answer when you can't.
whatsapp.connectHint: Your number keeps working exactly as it does on your phone.
whatsapp.notConfigured: The Meta app isn't configured yet. Contact Kuik support.
whatsapp.req_app: You need the WhatsApp Business app (not the regular one) on your phone.
whatsapp.req_active: The number must have been in active use for at least 7 days.
whatsapp.req_keeps_working: Your number keeps working normally on your phone; nothing is migrated away.
whatsapp.req_no_groups: Groups and status stay on your phone only.
whatsapp.req_no_history: Past conversations aren't imported; Kuik starts fresh.
whatsapp.needNumber: Connect a number above so the assistant can reply.
whatsapp.hint_enabled: Turns the whole WhatsApp system on.
whatsapp.hint_bot: If you reply from your phone, the assistant goes quiet in that chat.
whatsapp.hint_away: Says you're closed, but still handles the request.
whatsapp.hint_ai: Without AI the assistant uses flows and an options menu. With AI it understands free text.
whatsapp.hint_limits: These caps protect your spend and your number's quality rating with Meta.
whatsapp.messagesHint: What the assistant says in each situation.
whatsapp.goalsHint: Turn each thing the assistant knows how to do on or off.
whatsapp.goalFlow: Asks guests, day, time and name, then logs the request.
whatsapp.aiHint: Optional. Kuik supplies a key by default, or you can use your own.
whatsapp.tonePlaceholder: e.g. be formal, mention that parking is free…
whatsapp.aiFallbackNote: If the budget runs out or the AI fails, the assistant keeps working with its flows.
whatsapp.flowHint: The assistant asks one at a time, in this order, then reads it all back to confirm.
whatsapp.flow_optionsHint: Comma separated. Sent as tappable buttons; more than 3 become a list.
whatsapp.flow_confirmPlaceholder: Confirming: {{party_size}} guests on {{date}} at {{time}}. Is that right?
whatsapp.flow_preview: This is what the diner sees
whatsapp.pairHint: Scan a code with your phone, just like WhatsApp Web.
whatsapp.pair_step2: Go to Settings → Linked devices → Link a device.
whatsapp.pair_step3: Point the camera at this code.
whatsapp.pair_warnBody: This links Kuik as another device using an unofficial library. WhatsApp's terms don't allow it, and if they detect it they can ban this number — the same one printed on your menus. Meta's official route is slower to set up but carries no such risk.
whatsapp.pair_note_device: It uses one of your linked-device slots.
whatsapp.pair_note_phone_on: Your phone must come online at least every 14 days or it unlinks.
whatsapp.pair_note_no_buttons: Tappable buttons are sent as a numbered list; the diner replies with the number.
whatsapp.err_bridge_not_configured: The bridge service isn't configured. Contact Kuik support.
whatsapp.err_qr_timeout: The code expired. Generate a new one.
whatsapp.err_logged_out: It was unlinked from the phone.
whatsapp.err_client_outdated: The bridge needs updating. Contact Kuik support.
whatsapp.err_stream_replaced: Another session was opened with this number.
whatsapp.pair_expiredBody: Codes are short-lived for safety. Generate a new one and scan it right away.
whatsapp.err_qr_expired: The code expired. Generate a new one.
whatsapp.conflictBody: A number can only receive messages for one business at a time. Leaving it on both means one of them silently receives nothing.
whatsapp.conflictSupport: Some businesses listed aren't managed by you. Contact Kuik support to release them.
whatsapp.warnDisabled: Your number is connected but WhatsApp is off, so nothing gets answered. Turn it on below.
whatsapp.warnBotOff: Auto-replies are off: messages are recorded, but the assistant stays quiet.
whatsapp.aiLastFailure: The AI couldn't answer last time
